title: 08-05-2025 South Jordan City Council Meeting Minutes - FINAL

votes.motion: Council Member McGuire motioned to approve Resolution R2025-34, Consideration of a resolution authorizing the issuance and sale by the City of not more than $45,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Water Revenue Bonds, Series 2025; fixing the maximum aggregate principal amount of the Bonds, the maximum number of years over which the Bonds may mature, the maximum interest rate which the Bonds may bear, and the maximum discount from par at which the Bonds may be sold; delegating to certain officers of the City the authority to approve the final terms and provisions of the Bonds within the param

Council Member Harris motioned to approve Resolution R2025-43, Authorizing the Mayor to sign an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the City of South Jordan and Sandy City for 10000 S. Jordan Gateway to I-15 overlay
Council Member Shelton motioned to approve Resolution R2025-37, Authorizing an amendment to the South Jordan City Fee Schedule

Council Member Shelton motioned to approve Zoning Ordinance 2025-05-Z, Rezoning property located at 9450 South Redwood Road in the City of South Jordan from P-O (Professional Office) Zone to A-1 (Agricultural, minimum 1 acre lot) Zone; Tina Franco, Howland Partners (Applicant)
Council Member Zander motioned to approve Ordinance 2025-14, Fixing the compensation for the South Jordan City Recorder
Council Member McGuire motioned to adjourn the August 5, 2025 City Council Meeting
